title: Health Economics Associate
description:
Contribute to the development of health economic models that evaluate the cost\-effectiveness of health technologies for global reimbursement applications. Perform data analysis, assist in model building, and support senior team members in project execution.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
**Project Execution**
* Provide high quality, timely, scientific/strategic solutions to meet client needs
* Work on existing Health Economics models and start with country adaptations.
* Check health economic models, using appropriate software tools, to elucidate and express the economic value of clients’ products
* Systematically search for health economic models published in the scientific literature as well from Health Technology Assessment (HTA) bodies.


**Skills**
* Strong computing skills (MS Office)
* Excel knowledge at high level including writing of macros and VBA
* High analytical ability
* A high degree of written accuracy and attention to detail
* Good communication skills, both oral and in writing, especially in the relaying of technical information
* Self\-motivation, enthusiasm, ambition and flexibility
* Fluent English, another European language will be an asset
* Keen interest in medical research, provision of healthcare and the pharmaceutical industry


**Knowledge And Experience**
* 2\+ yrs of experience of programming and software such as VBA, SAS, R is an advantage.
* Training and/or experience in health economics and/or outcomes would be an advantage.
* Experience in a relevant role would be advantageous.


**Education**
* Master’s degree or equivalent in either life science or a quantitative discipline, such as health economics, economics, mathematics or statistics.

title: VSI - Chargé de mission - Administratif et Financier (F/H) - TOGO
description:
**Rejoignez l’Ordre de Malte France, une institution caritative emblématique au service des plus fragiles**
 Emanation française d’une institution caritative quasi millénaire, nous sommes une association catholique hospitalière, qui place la Charité au cœur de son engagement. Nous agissons auprès des plus fragiles à travers des initiatives de terrain dans les secteurs de la solidarité, de la santé, du médico\-social, et du secourisme. Reconnue d’utilité publique depuis 1928, notre association est également agréée de sécurité civile.
   

  

 Nous intervenons en France et dans 36 pays avec un budget d’environ 92,6 M€, 2 000 collaborateurs, et grâce à un réseau de 14 900 bénévoles.
   

  

**Pourquoi rejoindre notre équipe ?**
 Donner du sens à votre engagement professionnel en œuvrant pour l’humain
   

  

 Cadre de travail exceptionnel, à deux pas de la gare Montparnasse : 2 jardins permettant des moments de convivialité, séances d’ostéopathie, plateforme d'assistance sociale et en santé mentale
   

  

 Avantages : Télétravail possible deux jours par semaine, mutuelle prise en charge à 90% par l’employeur, ticket restaurant pris en charge à 60% par l'employeur, 4 jours de repos supplémentaires, une base horaire de 37h avec 12 RTT, avantages offerts par le CSE (chèques cadeaux, chèques vacances...)
   

  

 Salaire de XX à XX euros par an, 1% d'augmentation après 1 an d'ancienneté, CET, PERCO
   

  

**Recrutement**
 Notre processus de recrutement comprend un entretien téléphonique initial, un entretien en visio avec les RH, deux entretiens en présentiel avec le N\+1 et N\+2\. Nous prévoyons de finaliser le recrutement dans un délai de 4 semaines.
   

  

**Avantages**
* Logement fourni
* Indemnités
* Billet d'Avion A/R pris en charge par l'Ordre de Malte France
* Congés 24 jours ouvrés


 L’Hôpital d’Elavagnon agit dans la région de l’Est\-Mono au Togo depuis 1981, auprès des populations locales. Spécialisé dans l’accompagnement de la mère et de l’enfant, l’hôpital comprend 93 lits répartis au sein des services de pédiatrie, maternité, médecine et chirurgie.
   

  

 En lien avec le personnel de l’hôpital et les autorités locales, le
 **Volontaire de solidarité Internationale (VSI),** 
 véritable bras droit du directeur de l’hopital, sera en charge de coordonner les différents services administratifs, afin de veiller à la bonne gestion hospitalière.
   

  

**Ce Projet, Comprend Plusieurs Activités, Tels Que**
* Organisation et coordination de l’administration de l’hôpital
* Gestion financière, gestion de trésorerie, gestion budgétaire et contrôle de gestion
* Gestion des stocks et des immobilisations
* Relations extérieures
* Organisation d’évènements au sein de l’hôpital


 Au sein de ce projet, le VSI sera chargé des missions suivantes :
   

  

 1/
 **Organisation et coordination de l’administration de l’hôpital**
* Définir les procédures et les protocoles administratifs, de l’étude des besoins au suivi financier
* Contrôler le respect des procédures pour chaque service de l’hôpital et proposer des améliorations pour renforcer le bon fonctionnement de l’hôpital,


 2/
 **Gestion financière, gestion de trésorerie, gestion budgétaire et contrôle de gestion**
* Analyser les recettes et dépenses de l’hôpital et proposer des améliorations pour renforcer l’autonomie financière de l’hôpital,
* Superviser la gestion comptable et fiscale avec le comptable ; la gestion de la paie avec le service RH ; la prise en charge des indigents avec l’assistant social ;
* Conseiller et assister le directeur de l’hôpital en matière de gestion financière (engagement des dépenses, suivi de la trésorerie, faisabilité de nouveaux projets…),
* Participer à la rédaction des rapports d’activités et de leurs annexes financières,
* Préparer, en lien avec la direction, les budgets en conformité avec les orientations de la direction de l’Ordre de Malte France. Contrôler leur réalisation par activité, service (ex : pharmacie, fonctionnement de l’hôpital, etc.),
* Proposer et concevoir des outils d’analyse financière et budgétaire,
* Participer aux comités de direction et aux réunions des responsables de services pour apporter un éclairage budgétaire (conseil, contrôle et suivi).


 3/
 **Gestion des stocks et des immobilisations**
* Rationaliser la gestion des stocks de médicaments et superviser les commandes mensuelles pour satisfaire les besoins de l’hôpital tout en prenant en compte ses contraintes budgétaires,
* Contrôler la bonne utilisation et la bonne mise à jour des logiciels de gestion et les utiliser pour réaliser des analyses permettant d’améliorer le fonctionnement de l’hôpital,
* Gérer les immobilisations de l’hôpital.


 4/
 **Relations extérieures**
* Développer et entretenir les relations avec les fournisseurs de médicaments de l’hôpital,
* Superviser les relations avec les organismes de contrôle (Office Togolais des Recettes, EXCO).


 Pour ce volontariat, un Niveau Bac \+ 5 dans la gestion administrative ou tout autre diplôme annexe est requis.
   

  

 Nous recherchons une personne qui se reconnaît dans les
 **valeurs portées par l’Ordre de Malte** 
 et qui souhaite mettre son énergie et ses compétences au service d’un projet à forte dimension humaine.
   

  

 Une connaissance des enjeux sanitaires et des principes humanitaires ou une appétence pour ce domaine, ainsi qu’une première expérience en administration d’entreprise, en comptabilité, en finance ou en Afrique serait un plus !
   

  

 Le volontaire devra avoir des compétences en finances, comptabilité ou logistique et en maitriser les outils.
   

  

 Il devra faire preuve d’autonomie, de flexibilité, apprécier le travail en équipe et être organisé et être rigoureux.
   

  

 Ainsi qu’être capable de travailler dans un environnement multiculturel.
   

  

**Poste à pourvoir en novembre 2026 pour 12 mois.**
 Conditions d'indemnisation et de prise en charge conformes au statut VSI agréé par le ministère de l’Europe et des Affaires Étrangères (hébergement, transport, assurance, indemnité de subsistance).

title: Senior Manager Finance - M&A and Divestments
description:
**Job Purpose**
 In this role you will be responsible for evaluating, structuring, and executing the financial component of complex transactions that support the company’s strategic objectives, including acquisitions, divestitures, and strategic partnerships. You will be a key business partner for the M\&A team and provide an essential bridge between the world of transaction\-related finance and internal corporate finance and other functional teams.
   

  

 The role requires a strong blend of strategic thinking, transaction experience, financial acumen, and cross\-functional collaboration to support the company’s long\-term growth agenda. This will include financial evaluations and risk assessments on M\&A and divestments, negotiation support and presentation to the corresponding governance bodies, building in\-depth knowledge of the business and work closely with all needed stakeholders (eg tax, treasury, funds flow, and supply hubs) and conduct post\-evaluation of M\&A and divestment deals.
   

  

 The incumbent will be a key business partner for the M\&A team, connecting them through a lens of financial transactions to the broader Sandoz internal finance and other teams and bridging that gap.
   

  

**Major Responsibilities**
* Create financial modelling, valuation, and scenario analysis for M\&A and other strategic initiatives.
* Assist in due diligence processes and preparation of financial materials for internal and external stakeholders.
* Execute the financial aspects of integration and separation planning by supporting financial workstreams and tracking synergy realization or cost impacts.
* Collaborate with Strategy, Corporate Development, and Business Unit teams to evaluate investment opportunities and strategic options.
* Prepare business cases and financial presentations for senior leadership review.
* Conduct market and competitor financial analysis to support strategic recommendations.
* Ensure compliance with financial governance and internal controls throughout project execution.
* Supports post\-deal analysis and post\-implementation reviews to assess actual vs. planned outcomes of transformation and capture lessons learned. Required BPA activities around the finances of the Transformation and Growth function.
* Ad\-hoc requests and support.


**Key Performance indicators**
* Successful completion of projects
* Realization of synergies and value creation targets such as NPV, ROIC, payback
* Transformation Initiative delivery
* Accuracy and timeliness of forecasts
* On time and on budget integration and separation after transaction completion
* Compliance of financial processes with Sandoz Financial Control Framework requirements
* Meeting internal reporting deadlines


**Minimum Requirements**
* Chartered Accountant, MBA Finance / CFA
* 8–10 years of experience in Corporate Finance, investment banking, consulting, Corporate M\&A, due diligence or a similar analytical role.
* Strong financial modelling and analytical skills with attention to detail.
* Experience supporting M\&A, transformation or strategic finance projects is preferred.
* Excellent communication and presentation (Written and Verbal) skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively across functions and manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, financial analysis tools, and project tracking tools (e.g., MS Project, Smartsheet, or similar).
* Experience in life sciences, healthcare, or a similarly dynamic and regulated industry is a plus.


**Why consider Sandoz?**
 Generic and Biosimilar medicines are the backbone of the global medicines industry. Sandoz, a leader in this sector, provided more than 900 million patient treatments across 100\+ countries in 2025 and while we are proud of this achievement, we have an ambition to do more!
   

  

 With investments in new development capabilities, production sites, new acquisitions, and partnerships, we have the opportunity to shape the future of Sandoz and help more patients gain access to low\-cost, high\-quality medicines, sustainably.
   

  

 Our momentum is powered by an open, collaborative culture driven by our talented and ambitious colleagues, who, in return for applying their skills experience an agile and collegiate environment with impactful, flexible\-hybrid careers, where diversity is welcomed and where personal growth is supported!
   

  

 Join us!
   

  

**Commitment To Diversity \& Inclusion**
 We are committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse teams representative of the patients and communities we serve.

title: Oracle Fusion Financial Cloud Functional Consultant with AI
description:
**Job Description**
 We are looking for a skilled Oracle Fusion Consultant to join our team and drive innovation through AI integration. The successful candidate will play a pivotal role in automating business processes, improving decision\-making, and optimizing operational efficiency. By leveraging their expertise in Oracle Fusion Financials Cloud ERP and AI technologies, they will collaborate with business stakeholders to identify and implement AI use cases, ensuring compliance and delivering exceptional results.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Implement AI\-powered capabilities in Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, focusing on intelligent automation in Finance modules.
* Work closely with business stakeholders to identify AI use cases, such as invoice processing automation and predictive analytics.
* Configure and optimize AI\-driven features in Accounts Payables, Receivables, General Ledger, and other relevant modules.
* Integrate Oracle AI Agents and predictive analytics to enhance finance workflows and business processes.
* Analyze existing business processes and recommend AI\-driven improvements and automation opportunities.
* Collaborate with technical teams for seamless data integration, AI model configuration, and reporting enhancements.
* Ensure compliance with financial controls and business processes while implementing AI capabilities.
* Conduct thorough system testing, provide UAT support, and deliver user training for AI\-enabled functionalities.
* Prepare comprehensive documentation for configurations, AI workflows, and business process improvements.
* Stay updated with the latest advancements in Oracle AI features and industry best practices.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, or a related field.
* Strong experience in Oracle Fusion Financials Cloud ERP implementations, particularly in Accounts Payables, Receivables, and General Ledger.
* In\-depth knowledge of Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) AI services and Machine Learning concepts.
* Experience with RPA (Robotic Process Automation) and AI\-driven automation technologies.
* Oracle certifications in Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials or Oracle Cloud technologies are highly preferred.
* Proven track record in AI\-enabled finance automation projects.
* Excellent understanding of business process automation and AI integration in finance systems.
* Proficiency in data analytics, reporting tools, and Oracle Transactional Business Intelligence (OTBI).
* Ability to work collaboratively with cross\-functional teams and effectively communicate with stakeholders.
* Analytical mindset with a problem\-solving approach and a passion for driving innovation through technology.

title: Senior Solution Analyst - Finance
description:
Senior Solution Analyst \- Finance \- SAC Planning \& Forecasting
   

  

 Sandoz is undergoing an exciting transformation as a global leader and pioneering provider of sustainable Biosimilar and Generic medicines. As we continue on this ambitious journey, we offer unique opportunities for professionals to grow, innovate, and make a meaningful impact. Join us and help shape the future of healthcare.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a
 **Senior Solution Analyst \- Finance \- SAC Planning \& Forecasting** 
 to support the design, implementation, and optimization of finance technology solutions. In this role, you will partner closely with business and technical stakeholders to deliver planning, forecasting, reporting, and analytics capabilities leveraging SAP technologies and integrated enterprise data platforms.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

**Your Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To**
* Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document functional and technical requirements for finance planning, forecasting, and reporting solutions.
* Design end\-to\-end technology solutions aligned with business objectives and enterprise architecture standards.
* Lead and support the implementation of SAP\-based planning and forecasting solutions, ensuring quality delivery within agreed timelines and budgets.
* Ensure seamless integration between SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), SAP S/4HANA, SAP BW, SAP DataSphere, and related reporting platforms.
* Serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, project teams, and technical experts to facilitate effective collaboration and decision\-making.
* Develop and execute testing strategies, test plans, and quality assurance activities to validate business requirements and solution performance.
* Create and maintain comprehensive documentation, including solution designs, implementation plans, test results, and support materials.
* Support user training, change management initiatives, and ongoing operational support to drive business adoption and maximize value realization.


**Key Performance Indicator (KPI)**
 Successful delivery of finance planning and reporting solutions, demonstrated through effective integration, stakeholder satisfaction, compliance adherence, and high\-performing systems.
   

  

 What You'll Bring to the Role
   

  

**Essential Requirements**
**Education**
* University Degree or Master's Degree with a focus on Finance \& Accounting.


**Experience**
* Minimum 10 years of SAP experience, including at least 5 years of hands\-on experience with SAP S/4HANA.
* Hands\-on expertise in SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) Planning \& Forecasting.
* Strong knowledge of SAP COPA/Margin Analysis and financial reporting processes.
* Experience integrating SAC with SAP BW, SAP DataSphere, BDC, and SAP S/4HANA environments.
* Proven experience in requirements analysis, solution design, and implementation management within large\-scale transformation programs.
* Strong background in testing, quality assurance, documentation, and stakeholder management.
* Experience working within regulatory, GxP, and data integrity compliance frameworks.


**Essential Skills**
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.
* Excellent stakeholder management and business partnering capabilities.
* Ability to translate business requirements into scalable and sustainable technology solutions.


**Languages**
* Fluent in English, both written and spoken.


 Desirable Requirements
   

  

* Experience working within pharmaceutical, life sciences, or other highly regulated industry environments.
* Knowledge of enterprise planning, forecasting, and performance management best practices across global organizations.


 You'll Receive
   

  

* Competitive compensation and benefits package.
* Flexible and hybrid working opportunities.
* Access to continuous learning and professional development programs.
* Career growth opportunities within a global organization.
* A collaborative, inclusive, and innovative work environment.
* Wellbeing initiatives and employee support programs.


 Why Sandoz?
   

  

 Generic and Biosimilar medicines are the backbone of the global healthcare industry. In 2024, Sandoz delivered more than 900 million patient treatments across over 100 countries. While we are proud of this achievement, our ambition is to do even more.
   

  

 Through continued investments in development capabilities, manufacturing sites, strategic acquisitions, and partnerships, we are creating opportunities to expand access to affordable, high\-quality medicines for patients worldwide.
   

  

 Our success is driven by talented and ambitious colleagues who thrive in an open, collaborative, and agile environment. At Sandoz, diversity is valued, innovation is encouraged, and personal growth is supported through meaningful and flexible career opportunities.
   

  

**Join us and help shape the future of healthcare.**

title: Spec-Business Intelligence
description:
When you join Verizon
   

  

 You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing...**
 At Verizon, we aren't just building a world\-class Financial Planning \& Analysis (FP\&A) organization—we are fundamentally redefining the future of finance. As we step into the AI era, we are pioneering intelligent, AI\-driven FP\&A practices that will completely transform how finance teams operate and deliver strategic value. Through a comprehensive initiative to streamline processes, modernize our systems, and invest heavily in the continuous growth of our people, we are setting the industry standard. This is your opportunity to be the catalyst for this AI\-powered revolution, helping us make Verizon the ultimate destination for forward\-thinking FP\&A professionals.
   

  

 Move Beyond Compiling Data And Help Tell The Story Behind The Numbers. The Corporate FP\&A Positions Offer Opportunities To Drive Better Business Partnering And Insights While Developing Your Skill Set And Leadership As We Continue To Grow As a World\-class Organization. You Are a Valuable Business Partner, Finding New And Better Ways Of Working By Leveraging Digital And AI Capabilities. You’ll Become Involved In Planning, Reporting, Analyses, And Initiatives That Will Impact Important Decisions Around The Growth And Development Of Verizon's Business. In Our Department, You Will
   

  

* Architect Intelligent Workflows: Identify bottlenecks in traditional FP\&A processes (like month\-end close or manual data consolidation) and spearhead the implementation of automations and AI solutions.
* AI\-Enhanced Data Storytelling: Transform complex, multi\-layered datasets into clear, actionable intelligence using advanced data visualization tools and AI\-generated insights.
* Bridge Finance and Technology: Act as the crucial link between traditional FP\&A and data science teams, ensuring AI algorithms are trained with deep financial context and commercial acumen
* Prompt Engineering for Finance: Utilize generative AI tools to rapidly synthesize financial data, draft preliminary variance narratives, and accelerate the reporting cycle.
* Ensure timely and accurate delivery of financial planning, reporting \& analyses for the business.
* Be a trusted advisor by providing valuable decision support and guidance to FP\&A Business Partners.
* Proactive Value Creation: Move beyond retrospective reporting to become a forward\-looking strategic advisor, using AI\-driven scenario planning to guide executive decision\-making and identify growth opportunities.
* Actively participate in the cultural and professional development of Corporate FP\&A as a world\-class organization through Mentor/Mentee relationships and various activities offered.
* Be the Impetus for Change: Champion the adoption of AI and modern finance practices across the broader Verizon team, overcoming resistance to change through education and proven results.


 As part of the Corporate FP\&A team, you will be helping the reporting and accounting teams deliver world\-class, zero\-touch automated solutions for all Verizon entities. You will interact with finance teams across the business, bringing new automated and AI\-driven solutions to life for our month\-end financial close and reporting activities.
   

  

**Reporting, Automation \& Data Visualization**
* Deliver best\-in\-class end\-to\-end automated solutions for our stakeholders to support Finance Business Units (BUs) and drive efficiencies.
* Design data visualizations of financial statements for different organizations across Verizon.
* Deliver C\-Suite Executive reporting with 100% quality and accuracy.
* Collaborate with the various stakeholders to deploy Qlik/ Looker Applications in production environments and resolve any production issues with existing applications.
* Document processes to ensure accuracy across the enterprise and maintain strict change control.


**AI \& Analytics Systems Architecture**
* Design and build AI solutions that interact with development tools, codebases, and team workflows in meaningful ways.
* Work extensively with LLM APIs (Claude, Gemini, Codex, and others) to understand their capabilities, limitations, and optimal application patterns for financial automation.
* Own the developer experience of agentic interactions—making complex AI capabilities feel natural and trustworthy for finance end\-users.
* Lead technical decision\-making on agent patterns, model selection, and integration approaches.


 What we’re looking for…
   

  

 You are a strong collaborator who can effectively own and prioritize multiple work streams and adapt during pressured situations. You display initiative and resourcefulness but are also comfortable brainstorming and sharing ideas in a team environment. You possess excellent communication skills and can partner effectively across multiple business and finance teams to speak to both internal and external stakeholders. You are adaptable to change, meet tight deadlines, and are strongly focused on the quality of your deliverables.
   

  

**You'll Need To Have**
* Bachelor’s degree and Four or more years of work experience in financial report automations.
* Five or more years of relevant work experience in Business Intelligence/Analytics within FP\&A teams (but not limited to this function).
* Hands on experience in Qlik Sense \& Tableau.
* Experience with Looker, LookML will be an added advantage
* Vizlib and NPrinting experience in Qlik Sense.
* Deep, hands\-on experience building AI agents or agentic systems in production.
* Strong understanding of LLM capabilities and limitations across multiple models (Claude, Gemini, Codex, etc.).
* Expertise in prompt engineering, model selection, and working with tool\-use/function calling.
* Ability to mine, extract, transform, and load large financial datasets to create zero\-touch reports.
* Working knowledge of report automation tools, technologies, and end\-to\-end ETL processes (e.g., Knime Analytics Platform, Alteryx).
* Experience with Qlik Sense and QVD generations from different data sources.
* Experience in Essbase, SQL, and SQL performance tuning.
* Knowledge of Google Suite, database management systems, and ticketing tools (e.g., Jira).


 Even better if you have one or more of the following:
   

  

* Familiarity with evaluation frameworks for agentic systems and understanding of the practical tradeoffs in production.
* Basic knowledge of programming languages essential for modern data and AI work (e.g., Python, Google App Scripting, React.js, etc.,).
* Background in developer tools, productivity platforms, or engineering analytics.
* Exposure to GCP Big Query and Teradata databases.
* A proven ability to derive insights from data and recommend actionable business strategies.


**Where you'll be working**
 In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.
   

  

 Where you’ll be working
   

  

 In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.
   

  

 Scheduled Weekly Hours
   

  

 40

工作职责:
   

  

**Job Description Summary**
 We are looking for an Assistant Cost Manager for our Site\-based team working at a Hyperscale Data Centre Campus. You will be highly organized, have excellent communication and team working skills and thrive in a dynamic and fast\-paced environment. You will have experience coordinating and managing commercial process flows and deliverables.
   

  

 This role will be supporting construction and retrofit projects in a live environment – with full collaboration and coordination with other teams and stakeholders.
   

  

 What this job involves
   

  

 Report to and support the Cost Manager on the related tasks listed below:
   

  

 Assist in the delivery of Commercial, Cost and Procurement tasks.
   

  

 Support the development of client commercial and procurement briefs.
   

  

 Conduct cost evaluations of contracts under supervision.
   

  

 Assist in administering contracts, ensuring compliance with terms and conditions.
   

  

 Support the compilation of procurement and tendering documents.
   

  

 Help develop project cost and procurement documentation, programs, and budgets.
   

  

 Assist in monitoring and reporting on contractor and sub\-contractor commercial progress.
   

  

 Support the management of consultant team contracts while maintaining focus on time, cost and quality.
   

  

 Assist in preparing and updating monthly dashboard reports to track project financial performance.
   

  

 Support the creation of detailed weekly and monthly reports on commercial positions
   

  

 Help conduct cashflow analysis and forecasting for ongoing projects.
   

  

 Assist in evaluating contractors' quotes and comparing them against project budgets.
   

  

 Support the compilation and review of tendering documentation.
   

  

 Help analyze tender returns and assist in contract negotiations.
   

  

 Contribute to the development of project cost documentation and master budgets.
   

  

 Assist in monitoring and reporting on main and specialist sub\-contractors' commercial progress against contracts.
   

  

 Support the management of consultant team contracts to ensure design compliance with commercial contracts and budgets.
   

  

 Help prepare cost evaluations of contracts to meet client expectations and budgets.
   

  

 任职条件:
   

  

 Interested? An ideal candidate would need to have the following qualifications
   

  

 Fluent in written and spoken Mandarin and intermediate level of English requried.
   

  

 2\-5 years' experience in a related field.
   

  

 Degree Qualification in Quantity Surveying, Construction Management, or related field.
   

  

 Experience in construction site environments.
   

  

 Good communication and reporting skills.
